answer: Physical Token Chain Mechanism: Rooted Token Chain This mechanism ties each digital identity to a physical token that must be continuously anchored to a real-world location through periodic cryptographic proofs. The system uses a willow tree planted at a specific GPS coordinate as the anchor point, where tokens must prove attendance through biometric verification at the same location within a fixed time window. An attacker cannot fake the hollow space between consecutive proof submissions, making temporal gaps cryptographically significant.
